about: The sources of GREGORIAN_ADOPTION (src/geo/calendar.ts), quoted for every row and for every date in its note. src/geo/calendar.test.ts checks the table against this file, and every tzdb quote against src/fixtures/tzdata-2025c-calendars. A quote's firstGregorian is the first New Style day it gives, null when it gives none; lastJulian, where it gives one, is the Old Style day before. noteSays is the text of the row's note that the quote supports. Grotefend's text is transcribed from the page images; spaced-out emphasis is set normally.
rule: One row per present-day country the sources date, for the region of its present capital where they date it. Where the sources disagree on that region, the row follows tzdb, which quotes the 1941 edition, the latest of the three; for Hungary all three give the legal change of 1587. A note's dates are tzdb's unless another source is named.

tzdb.citation: IANA Time Zone Database, release 2025c, file calendars. Its section "Grotefend's data" quotes H. Grotefend, Taschenbuch der Zeitrechnung des deutschen Mittelalters und der Neuzeit, herausgegeben von O. Grotefend (Hannover: Hahnsche Buchhandlung, 1941), pp. 26-28.

grotefend-1891.citation: H. Grotefend, Zeitrechnung des deutschen Mittelalters und der Neuzeit, vol. 1: Glossar und Tafeln (Hannover: Hahn'sche Buchhandlung, 1891), pp. 133-134, s.v. "Neuer Stil".
